text:
Alex: SlimWave deploy in ~30m — cross-service sync for API/runtime/console/router. Target change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Plan: small canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Pin versions: api v3.12.0, runtime r7.4.1, console c2.8.0, router rt-1.5. Please verify console compatibility flags before cut. @deploybot can you schedule the wave?

deploybot: deploybot scheduled 'slimwave' for 1740201800 (start). Canary group: zone-a. Ops command: `/deploy --wave slimwave --start 1740201800`

Tara: noted. I'm on metrics/tracing. I'll watch p99, errors, and request success rate. Can someone confirm kv-eviction config for the runtime change (r7.4.1)?

Ben: kv-eviction unchanged; this runtime flip is a kernel-batching tweak only. Ran a dry-run in staging this morning, looked fine.

Sam: console schema change is additive, no breaking changes. Drafted release notes: https://internal/release/notes/17402

Alex: rollback criteria proposed: >2% user-facing error increase sustained for 10m OR p99 latency >30% sustained 5m. If triggered we pin traffic back to api v3.11 / runtime r7.4.0. Sound reasonable?

Tara: agree. I'll post metric thresholds in #eng-monitoring pre-start. Also please enable quiet-window drains on the router for 5m during each traffic shift.

orch-bot: preflight checks: console schema migrated on staging: OK; api contract tests: OK; runtime binary signature: OK; router header-split flag present on 8/8 infra nodes.

Ben: small nit — header-split env var was only on EU nodes. I pushed a one-line infra patch to set it globally (infra/rt-env#123).

Alex: thanks. We need that rolled before start. @Liam /ops, can infra apply the hotfix within the next ~12m?

Liam: applying now, will confirm in ~3m.

Liam: rolled header-split env var to all nodes; verification: header-split enabled on 8/8.

deploybot: canary started 1740202100 -> traffic 10% to api v3.12.0 + runtime r7.4.1. Monitor metrics channel.

Tara: seeing a small bump +0.8% in errors on canary, p50/p90 look fine. Watching for trend.

Ben: KV hit-rate stable, kernel-batching metrics show ~2% CPU reduction on canary hosts.

Sam: console logs look clean. Release notes updated with rollback steps and observability pointers.

deploybot: traffic shifted to 50% at 1740202400.

Tara: p99 saw a 12% increase for ~3m but not sustained. Still below rollback thresholds.

Alex: proceed to 100% rollout in 10m unless we hit rollback criteria.

Tara: proceeding to 100% now — no sustained errors or user-impacting failures.

deploybot: full rollout complete 1740203000. Post-deploy checks: all green.

Sam: publishing final release notes and tagging changelog.

Alex: great work everyone. We'll keep the quiet window until 1740203600 and watch the dashboards for the next hour. If anything odd crops up we'll open a follow-up thread and consider a post-deploy review. :thumbsup:
